values.note: $50 per night with your own camper, $55 per holiday night (operator's About page, last modified 2026-08-31). Seasonal prices by phone. Dump station $15 and fresh-water fill $10 for campers not staying in the campground.

values.note: No booking engine: email a reservation request (contact form or lakegeorgecamp2@gmail.com) or call 989-588-4075 and the operator schedules you. Reserving specific dates needs one night paid in advance (non-refundable, good for a year if you reschedule); balance at check-in. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out by 3 p.m. Messages are returned Monday-Thursday; the camp store is staffed Friday-Sunday.

note: Family campground of about 74 wooded sites at 1935 S Jackson Ave, just off US-127 south of Harrison in Clare County (not the New York park of the same name); owned and run by the Baird family since 2017. Also rents cabins and two campers. Not on RV Life; Google 4.6 over 128 reviews. --Claude
